name: Emergency and trauma
summary: A Level II trauma center and 24-hour emergency department at Harlow Creek Medical Center.
highlights:
Board-certified emergency physicians, 24/7
Level II trauma designation
Dedicated pediatric emergency bays
Fast track for lower-acuity visits
body:
Our emergency department treats more than 48,000 visits a year. Trauma surgeons, emergency physicians and critical care nurses work together under one roof.

When to come here

  • Chest pain, stroke symptoms or trouble breathing
  • Serious injuries after a fall or crash
  • Sudden severe pain, bleeding that will not stop, or confusion

For sprains, fever and minor illness, Millhaven Urgent Care is usually faster.

name: Heart and vascular
summary: Cardiology, interventional procedures, cardiac imaging and vascular care across the system.
highlights:
Cardiology clinic at Creekway Heart Center
Cardiac catheterization lab on the main campus
Echo, stress and vascular imaging
Cardiac rehab referrals
body: Our heart team covers prevention, diagnosis and treatment. Many patients start in clinic at the Heart and Vascular Center and, when needed, move to the cath lab or operating rooms a short walk away.

name: Cancer care
summary: Medical oncology, infusion and coordinated radiation consults at Northridge Cancer Pavilion.
highlights:
Medical oncology and infusion in one pavilion
Private infusion chairs
Genetic counseling
Nurse navigators for every new patient
body: Cancer care at Harlow Creek is built around navigators who stay with you from the first visit through treatment. Infusion chairs are private; caregivers are welcome.

name: Orthopedics and sports medicine
tagline: Joints, bones and getting back to movement
summary: Joint replacement, sports medicine, fracture care and on-site physical therapy.
highlights:
Hip and knee replacement program
Sports medicine for adults and teens
Fracture clinic
Physical therapy on the same floor
body: Whether you need a new knee or help after a weekend soccer injury, the Orthopedic Institute puts surgeons and therapists in the same building.

name: Women's health and birth center
summary: Obstetrics, gynecology and a birth center with private labor and delivery rooms.
highlights:
Private labor and delivery rooms
Level III NICU on campus
Midwifery option
Gynecologic surgery
body: Our birth center has private rooms, 24-hour anesthesia coverage and a Level III NICU for babies who need extra care. Prenatal visits happen in clinic; birth happens on the main campus.

name: Pediatrics
tagline: Care for infants, children and teens
summary: Pediatric primary care, hospitalists and emergency bays designed for kids.
highlights:
Pediatric hospitalists on the main campus
Dedicated pediatric emergency bays
Primary care at Ashford Family Clinic
Child life support for procedures
body: Children who need to stay overnight are cared for by pediatric hospitalists. In the emergency department, dedicated bays keep younger patients close to nurses who specialize in kids.

name: Primary care
summary: Family medicine and internal medicine clinics across Harlow Creek, Millhaven and Ashford Crossing.
highlights:
Same-week sick visits at Ashford
Annual wellness visits
Chronic disease management
Patient portal messaging
body: Primary care is where most of your care should start. Our clinics offer wellness visits, vaccines, chronic disease follow-up and referrals into the rest of the system when you need a specialist.

name: Imaging and laboratory
summary: MRI, CT, ultrasound, X-ray and a full clinical laboratory on the main campus and at select clinics.
highlights:
MRI, CT, ultrasound and X-ray
Walk-in lab draws at the medical center
Results in the patient portal
Interventional radiology
body: Most imaging is done on the main campus. Lab draws are available without an appointment at the medical center outpatient lab during weekday hours.

name: Surgery
summary: General surgery, orthopedics, women's health and more, with a dedicated outpatient surgery wing.
highlights:
12 operating rooms on the main campus
Outpatient surgery wing with same-day discharge
Robotic surgery for select procedures
Pre-admission testing clinic
body: Our surgery team covers emergency and scheduled cases. Many procedures are done in the outpatient wing so you can go home the same day when it is safe.

name: Behavioral health
tagline: Mental health as part of whole care
summary: Outpatient psychiatry, therapy and integrated behavioral health in primary care.
highlights:
Outpatient psychiatry and therapy
Integrated counselors in primary care
Crisis assessment in the emergency department
Telehealth options for follow-up
body: Behavioral health is available on its own and inside our primary care clinics. Crisis assessments happen in the emergency department; ongoing care moves to outpatient clinics.
